rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary police officer.

example.english: That cop helped me find my phone.
example.traditional: 嗰個警察幫我搵返部電話。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 ging2 caat3 bong1 ngo5 wan2 faan1 bou6 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this colloquial Hong Kong term when referring casually to a police officer.

example.english: I saw a cop stopping cars at the junction.
example.traditional: 我見到差人喺路口截車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou3 caai1 jan4 hai2 lou6 hau2 zit3 ce1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a prison guard rather than a street police officer.

example.english: When I visited the prison, the cop told me to take off my hat.
example.traditional: 探監嗰陣，獄警叫我除低頂帽。
example.jyutping: taam3 gaam1 go2 zan6 juk6 ging2 giu3 ngo5 ceoi4 dai1 deng2 mou6
